jobs.title: Early Career, Associate Product Manager (2027)
jobs.description:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

We're looking for user-driven and deeply technical Associate Product Managers to join our rotation program. You'll help connect AI, design-to-code, and design systems workflows across Figma's suite of products, enabling our millions of users to go from idea to production faster. You'll be a liaison between design and engineering, working to solve complex user experience flows while ensuring they work for the underlying engineering architecture. This is a chance to experience all aspects of the product development process at a rapid pace while gaining exposure across multiple product areas.

This is a full time role based in our San Francisco hub with hybrid flexibility.

Applications must be submitted by Wednesday, October 21st, 2026 at 5:00pm PT to be considered.

What you'll do at Figma:

- Drive forward tightly-scoped, advanced features across Figma products

- Collaborate with fellow PMs to advance larger streams and define the multi-year vision for these interconnected product areas

- Work closely with customers as large as Microsoft to as small as solo designers to ensure the needs of all users at any scale are met

- Partner closely with engineering to ensure the systems are built in a scalable, performant way that advances our needs in the future

- Join forces with designers to find ways to present complex user flows in a simple and easy to understand format

- Participate in planning and prioritization, tracking key metrics, collaborating on marketing, messaging, positioning, and go-to-market plans

Some projects you could work on:

- Design system features that improve adoption and consistency at scale

- AI-powered workflows that streamline design processes and enhance creative capabilities

- New features that allow designers and developers to build custom plugins and tools

- New ways for teams to collaborate as they define, design, and build

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

- Comfortability working on deep, technically complex problems and have experience working on user-facing product launches

- A knack for visual design and/or design workflows

- Excitement about shaping how design evolves in an AI-powered world

- Experience with design systems, AI applications in design, or design-to-code tools

- A love for designers and building relationships with key customers, with excellent verbal and written communication skills for both internal teams and external high-profile clients

Read more about our team:

- Config 2026: New Materials, New Tools and a More Expressive Canvas

- What it Takes to Build Great Products Now

- You Never Stop Cultivating Taste

- 4 Way We're Using Our MCP Server at Figma

- Lead the product aspects of the four teams driving Figma's Roundtripping area - Code Context, Design to Code and Code to Design, and Code Platform

- Set vision, strategy, and goals for how design and code stay in sync at Figma

jobs.description:

Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

At Figma, we're building tools that help teams design, build, and ship better products together. Figma Make enables teams to go from prompt to production code, and the Figma agent is a purpose-built design agent that edits files directly on the Figma canvas.

We're looking for deeply technical Product Managers to own the developer platform: Figma’s MCP Server, REST API, and key first-party integrations like Figma for Slack and Figma for ChatGPT/for Claude.  These roles sit at the intersection of product and infrastructure. If you're excited about developer tooling, systems thinking, and building the foundations that other product teams ship on top of, this role is for you.

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.

What you'll do at Figma:

You’ll define and drive the strategy for one or more parts of our developer platform: the big bets, build-vs-buy calls, and how to sequence it all. Those areas:

- Design↔code platform: how we translate between designs in Figma’s SceneGraph to code in customers’ Makes and production codebases

- External platform: how external AI agents (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, etc.) access Figma context using our MCP Server & REST APIs, how and when Figma’s AI products appear in other surfaces (Slack, Microsoft Teams, etc.)

As you drive platform strategy, you’ll:

- Influence product roadmaps where platform capabilities create new product opportunities.

- Partner with EM and tech leads to make key architecture and UX decisions.

- Talk frequently with product teams , customers, and our partners & vendors, and distill learnings from those conversations into platform commitments.

- Raise the bar for technical PMs at Figma: pattern-match across the four areas, surface cross-cutting problems, and pull peers and EMs into the calls that need them.

- 6+ years of product management experience working on highly technical products

- Proven experience shipping developer tools, infrastructure products, or AI-powered technical systems
